bayts.text: And bless him, then grant peace, and his Family, his Companions and whoever has risen high.
And spare me today, through him, my enemies, and draw to me today, through him, the gifts.
And bless and grant peace upon the most pious, and spare me, by his standing, the evil of mankind.
And provide me sufficiency with what You have chosen for me, and in all affairs arrange for me.
And be for me in the outward and the inward, and be gentle with me in all situations.
And spare me the harm of creation and benefit them through me, here and tomorrow, and help them.
And bring my heart to life through him, and save me from every harm that may come at any time.
And guide me by his standing, and provide me acceptance in everything, O my Lord.
And make all my evil deeds good deeds, by his standing, and sustain me with righteous works.
And through the Prophet grant me conformity to the mighty character (Qurʾān 68:4), ever compassionate.
And grant me, by his standing, the following (of him), in word and deed, Lord, and eagerness.
Grant me the following of him in word, deed and character, O Possessor of bounty.
And make all that I have uttered in You and in him, Lord, or have written,
an accepted, well-pleasing worship with You, then pure with him.
And provide me today, by his immense standing, the abandoning of turning (elsewhere), a worshipper here and a servant.
And provide me extinction (fanāʾ) in You, then in him, and make me forever, by his standing, illustrious.
And bless, O Lord, the Chosen, and grant him peace, again and again.
And grant me sciences and works, with good manners, and guard my (spiritual) state for me.
Bless, O Lord, the Well-Known, and grant him peace with honour.
And spare me the harm of the mouth and the eye, and of sorcery, O Kind, and every blemish.
And bless, O Lord, the Honoured, and grant him peace, O Possessor of generosity.
And turn away from me through him all that destroys, and draw to me through him, Lord, what benefits.
And bless, O Lord, the Noble, and grant him peace with magnification.
And grant me, by his standing, length of life, with well-pleasing obedience and the warding off of harm.
And bless, O Lord, Yā Sīn (Muḥammad), and grant peace upon him and the guides.
And cut off through him all that is corruption for me, when it appears.
And bless, O Lord, the Wasīla (Muḥammad, the means of approach), with Your peace, and increase his pre-eminence.
And make me, today and after today, like the Companions in their prayer and fasting.
And bless, O Lord, Muḥammad, with an everlasting, renewed peace,
and his Family with the noble Companions, and make firm for me, through him, a good ending.
